$comment: The two environments, and what each one is made of: the 1Password note that holds its secrets (in `vault`, one field per variable, named as the Worker reads it) and the D1 database that holds its data, as apps/web/wrangler.jsonc binds it. The workstation is `staging`: dev:prepare reads its note; its data is the local D1 miniflare keeps. No value here, only names.
